title: Shopping cart for guests
context: Guests (not signed in) collect products in a cart before checkout. The web shop keeps the cart across page views; the same cart API is used by the mobile app.
actors: guest (not signed in) using the web shop
API client (e.g. the mobile app) using the cart API

sourcesRead.contributes: The whole requirement: description (guests, cart kept across page views, API shared with the mobile app, L17), the AC-1..AC-8 criteria table with layers (L19-L28) and the test-data note (in-stock product, anonymous carts that tests create and delete, L30). No attachments, no comments.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /carts creates an empty cart and responds 201 with its id.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: `POST /carts` creates an empty cart and responds 201 with its `id`.
outcomes: POST /carts responds 201
the response body contains the cart's id
the new cart is empty (reading it via GET /carts/{id} lists no products)

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /carts/{id} with product_id and a quantity from 1 to 99 adds the product (200); adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: `POST /carts/{id}` with `product_id` and a `quantity` from 1 to 99 adds the product (200); adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added.
outcomes: quantity 1 → 200 and the cart lists the product with quantity 1
quantity 99 → 200 and the cart lists the product with quantity 99
adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added (the cart lists it once, with the summed quantity)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A quantity outside 1–99 is rejected with 422 and an error for the quantity field; the cart is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: A quantity outside 1–99 is rejected with 422 and an error for the `quantity` field; the cart is unchanged.
outcomes: quantity 0 → 422
quantity 100 → 422
the error response contains an error for the quantity field
the cart is unchanged after the rejected request (same products and quantities as before)

acceptanceCriteria.text: On a product page, choosing a quantity and pressing "Add to cart" shows "Product added to shopping cart." and the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: On a product page, choosing a quantity and pressing "Add to cart" shows "Product added to shopping cart." and the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: product page of an in-stock product (web shop route /product/<id>, see G5)
outcomes: the message "Product added to shopping cart." is shown
the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items in the cart

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cart page (checkout step 1) lists each product with its quantity, unit price and line total (price × quantity), and the cart total.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: The cart page (checkout step 1) lists each product with its quantity, unit price and line total (price × quantity), and the cart total.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: cart page = checkout step 1 (web shop route /checkout, see G5), after adding products from their product pages
outcomes: every product in the cart is listed
each listed product shows its quantity
each listed product shows its unit price
each listed product shows its line total, equal to unit price × quantity
the cart total is shown

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId} removes the product (204); the cart no longer lists it.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: `DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId}` removes the product (204); the cart no longer lists it.
outcomes: DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId} responds 204
the cart no longer lists the removed product

acceptanceCriteria.text: Deleting a cart responds 204 and is idempotent: deleting a cart that was already deleted also responds 204.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: Deleting a cart responds 204 and is idempotent: deleting a cart that was already deleted also responds 204.
outcomes: deleting a cart → 204
deleting the same cart again → 204

acceptanceCriteria.text: Any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 with the message "Cart not found".
acceptanceCriteria.quote: Any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 with the message "Cart not found".
outcomes: a request for a cart id that never existed responds 404 (read, add product, remove product, delete cart)
the response carries the message "Cart not found"

endpoints.request: JSON body with product_id and quantity (1 to 99)

endpoints.success: the cart with its products and quantities
matching products (used to pick an in-stock product as test data)

rules.text: The web shop keeps the cart across page views.
A quantity from 1 to 99 is accepted when adding a product; a quantity outside 1–99 is rejected and leaves the cart unchanged.
The cart is for guests (not signed in); carts are anonymous.

errorModel.case: adding a product with a quantity outside 1–99
errorModel.body: an error for the quantity field

errorModel.case: any request for a cart that does not exist, including deleting a cart id that never existed (see G7 for deleting an already-deleted cart)

auth.mechanism: none: guests are not signed in and carts are anonymous

testData.strategy: Each test creates its own anonymous cart via POST /carts and fills it via POST /carts/{id} (API) or the product page (UI); products are picked via GET /products/search.
constraints: use any product that is in stock (story.md#L30)
carts are anonymous: no user account is needed (story.md#L30)
AC-5 needs a cart with more than one product and a quantity above 1, so line totals and the cart total are meaningful
AC-8 needs a cart id that never existed (not one of a cart the test deleted)
testData.cleanup: delete every cart the test created (DELETE /carts/{id}, G3) afterwards

gaps.element: conflict, limited to deleting a cart that was already deleted: AC-7 (L27) says the repeated delete responds 204, AC-8 (L28) says any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 "Cart not found"

tried.result: L27: deleting a cart that was already deleted responds 204; L28: any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404; neither line explicitly supersedes the other for the already-deleted case. A cart id that never existed is not covered by L27 and falls under L28 (404)
not asked: the contract extractor cannot ask; the caller should confirm with the product owner

gaps.value: only for a cart that was already deleted: deleting it again responds 204 (AC-7, the more specific statement). Every other request for a cart that does not exist, including DELETE /carts/{id} on a cart id that never existed, responds 404 "Cart not found" (AC-8)
gaps.evidence: story.md#L27 names the already-deleted case explicitly; story.md#L28 is the general rule and alone governs never-existing carts
